description.content: Atomic Creatives

This endpoint allows you to preview creative assets before they are permanently uploaded to the system. 
It validates the files and metadata, returning a preview of what will be created without actually 
storing the creatives. This is useful for verifying that your files and metadata are correct before 
committing to the upload.

formdata.description: (Required) JSON string containing metadata for all files
